# tenzir_current_user (Data Source)

The user that the provider's credential acts as, such as to make the account that manages an organization its owner with `tenzir_organization_member`. Needs no permission; fails for a credential that is no user's.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_current_user" "me" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The email address, if known.
- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `name` (String) The name, if known.
